name: ktx-openfl
description: KTX for OpenFL: KTX (Khronos Texture) GPU texture container support for OpenFL, with an optional Starling bridge. KTXv1 is supported; KTXv2 is detected and cleanly rejected for now.
releasenote: Version-agnostic API: Ktx v1/v2 detection, with v2 being cleanly rejected for now.
